products.body:
Celebrate the 20th anniversary of the beloved Disney Pixar movie Cars with this LEGO Speed Champions | Lightning McQueen (77255) building toy.

This construction set for boys and girls ages 9 and up includes many of the design details from the iconic movie character. The Disney model features Lightning McQueen's famous yellow and orange lightning bolt, number 95, Rust-Eze sponsor logo, tires imprinted with 'Lightyear' and his famous headlight stickers. The car toy is also the only Speed Champions model with a detailed undercarriage so kids can enjoy extra play value. A great gift idea for kids and car fans, LEGO Speed Champions building sets let them build replicas from an extensive range of iconic vehicles. They can create each playset with confidence using the LEGO Builder app, which lets them zoom, rotate in 3D and track progress with easy-to-follow digital instructions. Set contains 270 pieces.

products.body: Bring the beauty of pond life home with the LEGO Botanicals Water Lilies (11511) building set for girls, boys and plant lovers ages 9 years old and up. Kids’ imaginations will blossom as they craft 2 LEGO water lilies and discover their charming details. This set includes a vibrant pink water lily and a white water lily with yellow accents, plus 2 transparent vases for added authenticity. The transparent blue elements of the vases transition into transparent colorless elements to give the illusion that they are holding water. Some of the lily petals are opalescent, and all the petals can be adjusted to make them appear open or closed. Once the LEGO Water Lilies are complete, budding florists can display them proudly as beautiful flower decor for a bedroom or bookshelf. The flower craft kit also makes a gorgeous birthday or holiday gift idea. Kids can enjoy the Build Together mode in the LEGO Builder app, which lets them share the creative fun with friends and family. Contains 259 pieces.

products.body: Bring one of the most iconic gaming moments to life with the LEGO Minecraft Chicken Jockey (21582) building set for boys and girls ages 9 years old and up. A great gift idea for kids, this game-inspired building toy has everything they need to construct a large, posable chicken and a baby zombie figure. Both models can be positioned together to create a classic Minecraft moment that doubles as a cool piece of gaming themed room decor. Kids can recreate virtual adventures and imagine their own playful stories with the chicken’s movable wings and legs, as well as the baby zombie’s jointed legs, arms and head. There’s even a buildable baby chicken to join in on the fun. Kids can set the baby zombie on the chicken to create a chicken jockey, just like in the game, or pose the figures separately for display on a shelf, desk or nightstand. The LEGO Builder app lets kids build with confidence, allowing them to zoom in, rotate models in 3D, save sets and track their progress using a digital version of the printed instructions. Contains 344 pieces.

products.body: The LEGO Group joins the F1 ACADEMY grid—F1's all-female racing series! The LEGO Speed Champions F1 ACADEMY LEGO Race Car (77258) building toy lets kids ages 10 and up construct an authentic replica of the LEGO Group's race car, making its F1 ACADEMY debut in 2026. The detailed F1 ACADEMY LEGO car features 'Pirelli' imprinted tires, a rear wing, and a cockpit. A female F1 ACADEMY driver minifigure equipped with a helmet, wig and wrench can be placed inside the cockpit for pretend play racing adventures. When playtime ends, young racing fans can display their toy car in their bedroom or playroom as cool decor. LEGO Speed Champions building toys (each sold separately) let passionate car fans young and old build detailed toy cars modeled after some of the world's most iconic vehicles. This interactive construction challenge makes an exciting birthday, holiday or any-occasion gift for boys and girls who love F1 racing, car toys, and high-speed action. For enhanced building fun, the LEGO Builder app offers easy-to-follow digital instructions and tools to zoom, rotate models in 3D and track progress. Contains 201 pieces.

products.body: Open up a world of imagination with the LEGO Friends Creative Dollhouse Suitcase (42697) building toy for girls and boys ages 6 years old and up. The house’s 8 rooms can be customized with a variety of fun dollhouse furniture and accessories. And when it's time to go, the entire set can be folded up into a suitcase for easy movability. The removable room scenes and 2 minidoll characters provide hours of creative play, allowing kids to practice their imagination and social skills. The portable dollhouse includes 2 bedrooms, a bathroom, kitchen, living room and an entrance hall, plus a garden and pool area. This imaginative pretend play toy makes a great gift for creative kids. For an intuitive building experience, girls and boys can check out the LEGO Builder app, where they can zoom in, rotate models in 3D, save sets and track their progress using a digital version of the printed instructions. Contains 355 pieces.

products.body: Kids can head out on the ultimate camping adventure with the LEGO Friends Nature Glamping Cabin (42682) building toy for girls and boys ages 6 years old and up. This cozy A-frame cabin sets the scene for kids to act out their own nature and friendship stories alongside the Nova and Liann minidolls, plus an animal figure of Shadow the kitten. The building kit comes with everything kids need for both indoor and outdoor storytelling, including a mountain bike with a helmet, beds for each of the characters, a small kitchen and a garden. And of course, no glamping trip is complete without snacks, drinks, pet food, a lamp, plant, watering can, rug, camera and a phone with a map. This camping playset makes a cute gift for nature lovers, girls and boys who love imaginative role play, or for any child who enjoys creative storytelling. Kids can enjoy intuitive building with the LEGO Builder app, where they can zoom in, rotate models in 3D, save sets and track their progress using a digital version of the printed instructions. Contains 295 pieces.

products.body: Kids can discover 1 of 12 collectible characters with the LEGO Minifigures Series 29 (71052) mystery box for boys and girls ages 6 years old and up. Each sealed package contains 1 random minifigure from a lineup of 12 characters to collect: a Soccer Goalkeeper, Marine Biologist, Tuba Player, Unicorn Elf, Monster Hunter, Robot T. rex, Chocolatier, Boba Cup Fan, Bionicle Cosplayer, Mysterious Ronin, Cute Witch and Trash Monster. Every minifigure comes with at least 1 themed accessory to inspire creative play and imaginative storytelling. Kids can show off their minifigure on a shelf alongside other LEGO Minifigures Series 29 characters (sold separately) or keep building out their collection one mystery box at a time. Makes a cool kids' party favor, goodie bag stuffer or small surprise for young LEGO fans and minifigure collectors. Contains one mystery minifigure with at least one themed accessory.

products.body: Delight young nature lovers with the LEGO Botanicals Cosmos Flowers (11514) building toy for girls and boys ages 9 years old and up. This charming LEGO flower building set includes everything kids need to construct a beautiful floral bouquet featuring 3 detailed purple, white and pink cosmos flowers and 2 stems of fluffy red fountain grass. Builders can even discover a tiny LEGO bug hiding among the brick-built blooms! Between playtimes, kids can channel their inner florist by rearranging their bouquets and placing them on a table or shelf to create cheery playroom or bedroom decor. This creative floral playset can be added to other arrangements in the LEGO Botanicals collection (each sold separately) for greater customization and larger displays. Makes a great birthday gift for kids and a thoughtful holiday present for young nature lovers. Kids can also enjoy a collaborative building experience with the Build Together mode in the LEGO Builder app, where they can share the fun with friends and family while following a digital version of the printed instructions. Contains 171 pieces.

products.body:
Hit the racetrack to enjoy the thrill of Formula 1® racing with this range of LEGO® F1® Collectible Race Cars (71049) mystery boxes for kids. This is a fun gift for boys and girls aged 6 and up to inspire great storytelling and hours of playtime on their own or with friends.

There is 1 surprise LEGO F1 Collectible Race Car in each vehicle kit and a total of 12 to collect: an F1 car, an F1 ACADEMY™ car, and 10 cars from the Formula 1 teams: RB20, Mercedes-AMG, Ferrari, McLaren, Aston Martin, Alpine, Williams, VCARB, Sauber and Haas.

 Each toy model car comes in the colors of an F1 team, with team logos, a large helmet in the cockpit and moving wheels for F1 fans to stage exciting races. Kids and car model collectors can build, display and play out action with these unique and amazing toy vehicles.

products.body: Beach-inspired adventures await young kids ages 4 years old and up with the LEGO Disney Beach Fun with Lilo & Stitch (43280) building toy. This dynamic Disney playset features 2 LEGO Disney minifigures of Lilo and Stitch, a small, moving rocket ride and a beach section with a surf shop, slide, shave-ice shop and music stage, each with interactive features for hours of pretend play. Accessories including a guitar, surfboard, shave-ice cones and more can boost active, imaginative fun. Perfect as a birthday or holiday gift idea for preschool girls and boys, this set has everything kids need to play out exciting Lilo & Stitch adventures. The included Starter Brick elements ensure a quick and sturdy start, and each bag of bricks has a full model and minifigure so play can begin fast. Along with simple pictorial instructions for those learning to read, kids can check out the LEGO Builder app to zoom in, rotate models in 3D, save sets and track their progress using digital instructions. Contains 113 pieces.
